Nowadays, hyper-threading, operating systems, and applications have evolved a bit, so it's not as significant of a concern at all. rarely use three-star materials to upgrade anything, with a few exceptions...

**Cards** use them to upgrade or enhance them depending on the situation...

**Growth ISOs** always use three stars to upgrade. Don't sell your one or two-star growth ISOs until you finish that upgrade session, as you might end up with a five-star ISO that only needs a small percentage to complete. Then use your one or two-star growth on it (why waste a three-star or higher for a small percentage?)

**Obelisk** if all the stats are poor, like a stun resistance with a fear resistance and all defense, use that to upgrade a four-star or higher. Otherwise, put it on one of your lower-tier characters to make them a little less ineffective for team battles.
